blocking_findings: Current R162/R172 readouts mix search-branch Full/Search-only/Counterfactual views with recommendation-branch History-only/Search-masked views.
Official UnifiedSSR exposes separate recommendation and search task heads: next_product_predict for the recommendation branch and next_product_search for the query-conditioned search branch.
Keeping all views in the search branch is runnable but changes the estimand to query-conditioned search rather than native recommendation.
Keeping all views in the recommendation branch is runnable only by dropping focal query/source structure, so focal-source identity is no longer a runtime input.
A custom unified-head/source-augmented variant would be a derived model ablation, not a released UnifiedSSR checkpoint audit.
claim_ceiling: bounded official-code compatibility/provenance only; no paper-facing UnifiedSSR FocalSwap result
